notes_for_editor: Only two detailed pages plus the FFLA list. Idaho Fire Lookouts states it has no documented staffing history, so staffing is left out of the facts and the story. The access level is omitted because no source gives an access rule; the only access statement is the hike-in label. Elevation is 8,565 ft per both pages; the record's elevation_m is null. Do not confuse this with Shellrock Peak, a different tower (FFLA list: 44.95651, -114.93658; NHLR US 1454, ID 147; listed as standing). Several search results blended the two names. The record already has the 1967 abandoned event; the 1936 build is new. Nothing found describes the site today or whether it is open to visitors.
